invariants.rationale: The method expects a non-null list of HoodieRecord<T> to perform bulk insert operations.
The instantTime parameter is used as an identifier for the operation and should be a valid, non-empty string.
Option objects should not be null; they represent present or absent values.
A Java List's size is always non-negative; ensures records is a valid List.
The third argument must always be an Option<BulkInsertPartitioner> instance per method signature.
